atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLookback = input(50, "Coil Lookback", 10, 100, 1)
vovLookback = input(20, "VoV Lookback", 5, 50, 1)
coilThreshold = input(0.75, "Coil Threshold", 0.5, 0.95, 0.05)
predictThreshold = input(0.55, "Predict Threshold", 0.1, 0.9, 0.05)
releaseMult = input(1.5, "Release Mult", 1.1, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

rng = high - low
rngHigh = highest(rng, coilLookback)
rangeCoil = rng / max(rngHigh, 0.0001)
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
atrHigh = highest(atrVal, coilLookback)
atrCoil = atrVal / max(atrHigh, 0.0001)
coilLoad = 1 - (rangeCoil + atrCoil) / 2
atrPrev = atrVal[1]
atrChange = (atrVal - atrPrev) / max(atrPrev, 0.0001)
volOfVol = stdev(atrChange, vovLookback)
volOfVolPrev = volOfVol[1]
volOfVolRising = volOfVol > volOfVolPrev
sumRange = sma(rng, coilLookback) * coilLookback
effMove = abs(close - close[coilLookback])
tapePred = effMove / max(sumRange, 0.0001)
predictable = tapePred > predictThreshold
rngLow = lowest(rng, coilLookback)
releaseRange = rng > releaseMult * rngLow and rng > rng[1]
releaseAtr = atrVal > atrPrev and volOfVolRising
baseUp = coilLoad > coilThreshold and volOfVolRising and releaseRange and releaseAtr and close > open
baseDn = coilLoad > coilThreshold and volOfVolRising and releaseRange and releaseAtr and close < open
buySig = baseUp and not baseUp[1]
sellSig = baseDn and not baseDn[1]
zRatio = rng / max(atrVal, 0.0001)

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Release Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate")
    barcolor("#22cc88")
}

if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Release Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "separate")
    barcolor("#ff4477")
}

plot(coilLoad, "Coil Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(tapePred, "Tape Predictability", "#b48cff", 2, "separate")
plot3d(coilLoad, "Coil X", "scatter", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(tapePred, "Tape Y", "bars3d", "#b48cff", "separate", 1)
plot3d(zRatio, "Range Atr Z", "line3d", "#ffd43b", "separate", 2)

lookback = input(20, "Session Length", 10, 100, 1)
htfConfirm = input(2, "HTF Confirm Bars", 1, 5, 1)
minDisp = input(0.1, "Min Structure Displacement %", 0.01, 2.0, 0.01)
confThresh = input(60, "Confidence Threshold", 1, 100, 1)
hardStopOff = input(10, "Hard Stop Offset", 1, 100, 1)

sessHigh = highest(high, lookback)
sessLow = lowest(low, lookback)
sessHighPrev = sessHigh[1]
sessLowPrev = sessLow[1]

htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)
htfClose = security("1h", close)
htfHigh1 = htfHigh[1]
htfHigh2 = htfHigh[2]
htfHigh3 = htfHigh[3]
htfHigh4 = htfHigh[4]
htfHigh5 = htfHigh[5]
htfLow1 = htfLow[1]
htfLow2 = htfLow[2]
htfLow3 = htfLow[3]
htfLow4 = htfLow[4]
htfLow5 = htfLow[5]

bull1 = htfHigh > htfHigh1 and htfLow > htfLow1
bull2 = htfHigh1 > htfHigh2 and htfLow1 > htfLow2
bull3 = htfHigh2 > htfHigh3 and htfLow2 > htfLow3
bull4 = htfHigh3 > htfHigh4 and htfLow3 > htfLow4
bull5 = htfHigh4 > htfHigh5 and htfLow4 > htfLow5
bear1 = htfHigh < htfHigh1 and htfLow < htfLow1
bear2 = htfHigh1 < htfHigh2 and htfLow1 < htfLow2
bear3 = htfHigh2 < htfHigh3 and htfLow2 < htfLow3
bear4 = htfHigh3 < htfHigh4 and htfLow3 < htfLow4
bear5 = htfHigh4 < htfHigh5 and htfLow4 < htfLow5

bullBase = bull1
bearBase = bear1
if htfConfirm >= 2 {
    bullBase = bullBase and bull2
    bearBase = bearBase and bear2
}
if htfConfirm >= 3 {
    bullBase = bullBase and bull3
    bearBase = bearBase and bear3
}
if htfConfirm >= 4 {
    bullBase = bullBase and bull4
    bearBase = bearBase and bear4
}
if htfConfirm >= 5 {
    bullBase = bullBase and bull5
    bearBase = bearBase and bear5
}
htfFilled = htfHigh > 0 and htfLow > 0 and htfClose > 0 and htfHigh1 > 0 and htfLow1 > 0
sessFilled = bar_index >= lookback and sessHighPrev > 0 and sessLowPrev > 0
bullStructure = bullBase and htfFilled
bearStructure = bearBase and htfFilled

safeHigh = htfHigh1 + 0.000000001
safeLow = htfLow1 + 0.000000001
dispUp = (htfClose - htfHigh1) / safeHigh * 100
dispDn = (htfLow1 - htfClose) / safeLow * 100
dispOkBull = dispUp > minDisp
dispOkBear = dispDn > minDisp
dispBonusBull = bullStructure and dispOkBull
dispBonusBear = bearStructure and dispOkBear
dispBonus = dispBonusBull or dispBonusBear
dispAdd = dispBonus ? 25 : 0

bullNoFail = htfLow >= htfLow1
bearNoFail = htfHigh <= htfHigh1
wickOkBull = bullStructure and bullNoFail
wickOkBear = bearStructure and bearNoFail
wickOk = wickOkBull or wickOkBear
wickAdd = wickOk ? 25 : 0

quality = 50 + dispAdd + wickAdd
confScore = quality / 100

var curPos = 0
var curStop = 0.0

longStopNew = sessLow - hardStopOff
shortStopNew = sessHigh + hardStopOff

buyTrig = sessFilled and htfFilled and crossover(close, sessHighPrev) and bullStructure and quality >= confThresh
sellTrig = sessFilled and htfFilled and crossunder(close, sessLowPrev) and bearStructure and quality >= confThresh

longStopHit = curPos == 1 and crossunder(close, curStop)
shortStopHit = curPos == -1 and crossover(close, curStop)
longOppExit = curPos == 1 and crossunder(close, sessLowPrev)
shortOppExit = curPos == -1 and crossover(close, sessHighPrev)
longExitSig = longStopHit or longOppExit
shortExitSig = shortStopHit or shortOppExit

if buyTrig {
    model.confidence(confScore)
    model.stopLoss(longStopNew)
    model.shortExit("siege")
    model.longEntry("siege")
    curPos := 1
    curStop := longStopNew
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellTrig {
    model.confidence(confScore)
    model.stopLoss(shortStopNew)
    model.longExit("siege")
    model.shortEntry("siege")
    curPos := -1
    curStop := shortStopNew
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if longExitSig {
    model.exit("siege")
    curPos := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Exit", "diamond", "#ffcc00")
}
if shortExitSig {
    model.exit("siege")
    curPos := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Exit", "diamond", "#ffcc00")
}

flatStop = bullStructure ? longStopNew : bearStructure ? shortStopNew : longStopNew
hardStopPlot = curPos == 1 ? curStop : curPos == -1 ? curStop : flatStop

plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(hardStopPlot, "Hard Stop", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")

momLen = input(12, "Momentum Length", 5, 30, 1)
volLook = input(14, "Volatility Lookback", 5, 50, 1)
brkLook = input(20, "Breakout Lookback", 5, 100, 1)
expFactor = input(1.2, "Volatility Expansion Factor", 0.5, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

mom = close - close[momLen]
volBase = highest(high, volLook) - lowest(low, volLook)
curRange = high - low
volBaseAvg = volBase / volLook
volRatio = curRange / (volBaseAvg + 0.000001)
brkHigh = highest(high[1], brkLook)
brkLow = lowest(low[1], brkLook)
volExpanded = volRatio > expFactor
volAlertEdge = volExpanded and not volExpanded[1]
breakUp = crossover(close, brkHigh)
breakDown = crossunder(close, brkLow)
priceBreak = breakUp or breakDown
buySig = breakUp and mom > 0 and volExpanded
sellSig = breakDown and mom < 0 and volExpanded
alertSig = volAlertEdge and not priceBreak

if buySig {
plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy 3D", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "3d")
}
if sellSig {

plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell 3D", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
}
if alertSig {
plotshape(bar_index, high, "Vol Alert", "diamond", "#ffcc00")
}

bgcolor(volExpanded, "#332211")
plot(brkHigh, "Breakout High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(brkLow, "Breakout Low", "#4488ff", 1, "stepline")
plot(mom, "Momentum", "#22cc88", 1, "separate")
hline(0, "#888888", "separate")
plot3d(brkHigh, "Breakout High 3D", "line3d", "#ff4477", "3d", 0)
plot3d(brkLow, "Breakout Low 3D", "line3d", "#4488ff", "3d", 1)
plot3d(mom, "Momentum 3D", "bars3d", "#22cc88", "separate", 0)

fib382 = swingHigh - rng * f382Lvl
fib50 = swingHigh - rng * f50Lvl

if buySig {

}

plot(fib236, "23.6%", "#00ccff", 1, "stepline")
plot(fib382, "38.2%", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")
plot(fib50, "50%", "#b48cff", 1, "stepline")
plot(fib618, "61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

plot3d(fib382, "Fib 38.2%", "line3d", "#ffcc00", "3d", 1)

plot3d(fib618, "Fib 61.8%", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 3)

fastLen = input(10, "Fast Len", 5, 30, 1)
medLen = input(30, "Med Len", 15, 60, 1)
slowLen = input(60, "Slow Len", 30, 120, 1)
skewLen = input(60, "Skew Len", 20, 120, 1)
compressionThresh = input(0.10, "Compression Thresh", 0.02, 0.50, 0.01)
skewBull = input(0.20, "Skew Bull", 0.05, 0.80, 0.05)
skewBear = input(-0.20, "Skew Bear", -0.80, -0.05, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

r = log(close / close[1])
fastVol = stdev(r, fastLen) * sqrt(fastLen)
medVol = stdev(r, medLen) * sqrt(medLen)
slowVol = stdev(r, slowLen) * sqrt(slowLen)
hi = highest(high, skewLen)
lo = lowest(low, skewLen)
rng = hi - lo
pos = (close - lo) / (rng + 0.000000001)
skew = pos * 2 - 1
spreadFastSlow = fastVol - slowVol
spreadMedSlow = medVol - slowVol
spreadFastMed = fastVol - medVol
avgVol = (fastVol + medVol + slowVol) / 3
fastSkewMag = fastVol * (1 + pos * 0.1)
comp = (slowVol - fastVol) / (slowVol + 0.000000001)
compressed = comp > compressionThresh and fastVol < medVol and fastVol < slowVol
ready = bar_index > slowLen
expansion = compressed[1] and compressed == false and fastVol > fastVol[1] and fastVol > medVol and ready
buySig = expansion and skew[1] <= skewBull and skew > skewBull
sellSig = expansion and skew[1] >= skewBear and skew < skewBear

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, fastVol, "Buy 3D", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, fastVol, "Sell 3D", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "separate")
}

plot(spreadFastSlow, "Fast-Slow Spread", "#22cc88", 1, "separate")
plot(spreadFastMed, "Fast-Med Spread", "#ffaa00", 1, "separate")
plot(skew, "Skew", "#4488ff", 1, "separate")
hline(skewBull, "#22cc88", "separate")
hline(skewBear, "#ff4477", "separate")
hline(0, "#888888", "separate")
plot3d(avgVol, "Term Structure Manifold", "manifold", "#4488ff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(fastVol, "Fast Vol Spine", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "separate", 1)
plot3d(fastSkewMag, "Fast Vol Impulse", "bars3d", "#ffaa00", "separate", 2)

ch1 = input(20, "Ch1 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
ch2 = input(40, "Ch2 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
ch3 = input(60, "Ch3 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
ch4 = input(80, "Ch4 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
ch5 = input(100, "Ch5 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
CylinderMaxHeight = input(100.0, "Cylinder Max Height", 10.0, 200.0, 5.0)

markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

wob = (close - open) * 4.0 + ((bar_index % 7) - 3) * 0.6 + (high - low) * 0.5

C3raw = ch3 + wob
C4raw = ch4 + wob
C5raw = ch5 + wob

C4 = max(0, min(100, C4raw))
C5 = max(0, min(100, C5raw))

h1 = (C1 / 100) * CylinderMaxHeight
h2 = (C2 / 100) * CylinderMaxHeight
h3 = (C3 / 100) * CylinderMaxHeight
h4 = (C4 / 100) * CylinderMaxHeight
h5 = (C5 / 100) * CylinderMaxHeight

hAvg = (ArrayAvg / 100) * CylinderMaxHeight
splineH = h3 + (hAvg - h3) * 0.5 + (close - open) * 0.2
thick = SplineBaseWidth + SplineGain * ArrayAvg

}

plot(h1, "Cyl1 H", "#ff4477", 1, "separate")
plot(h5, "Cyl5 H", "#22cc88", 1, "separate")
plot(hAvg, "Array Avg H", "#ffcc00", 2, "separate")

plot3d(splineH, "Top Spline", "ribbon", "#ffcc00", "separate", 1)

wX = input(1.0, "Wind Dir X", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
wY = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Y", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
wZ = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Z", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
baseSpeed = input(10.0, "Wind Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 0.5)
maxSpeed = input(50.0, "Max Scale Knots", 10.0, 100.0, 1.0)
baseTail = input(1.0, "Base Tail Length", 0.2, 5.0, 0.1)
perKnot = input(0.1, "Length Per Knot", 0.01, 0.5, 0.01)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

chg = change(close)
rng = high - low
body = close - open

wx = wX + chg * 0.02
wy = wY + body * 0.02
wz = wZ + rng * 0.01

dynSpeed = baseSpeed + abs(chg) * 2.0 + rng * 0.5

lenSq = wx * wx + wy * wy + wz * wz
len = sqrt(lenSq)
lenSafe = len < 0.000001 ? 0.000001 : len

xn = wx / lenSafe
yn = wy / lenSafe
zn = wz / lenSafe

var pxn = 1.0
var pyn = 0.0
var pzn = 0.0

fxn = len > 0.000001 ? xn : pxn
fyn = len > 0.000001 ? yn : pyn
fzn = len > 0.000001 ? zn : pzn

absFxn = abs(fxn)
absFyn = abs(fyn)
absFzn = abs(fzn)

horiz = sqrt(fxn * fxn + fyn * fyn)
horizSafe = horiz < 0.000001 ? 0.000001 : horiz

fxnSafe = absFxn < 0.000001 ? 0.000001 : absFxn
yawAbsR = absFyn / fxnSafe
yawU = yawAbsR > 1.0 ? 1.0 / yawAbsR : yawAbsR
yawA = yawU / (1.0 + 0.28 * yawU * yawU)
yawA2 = yawAbsR > 1.0 ? 1.5707963 - yawA : yawA
yawQuad = fxn < 0.0 ? 3.1415927 - yawA2 : yawA2
yawBase = absFxn < 0.000001 ? 1.5707963 : yawQuad
yawRad = fyn < 0.0 ? 0.0 - yawBase : yawBase

pitchAbsR = absFzn / horizSafe
pitchU = pitchAbsR > 1.0 ? 1.0 / pitchAbsR : pitchAbsR
pitchA = pitchU / (1.0 + 0.28 * pitchU * pitchU)
pitchBase = pitchAbsR > 1.0 ? 1.5707963 - pitchA : pitchA
pitchRad = fzn < 0.0 ? 0.0 - pitchBase : pitchBase
rollDeg = 0.0

yawDeg = yawRad * 57.29578
pitchDeg = pitchRad * 57.29578

tailLen = baseTail + perKnot * dynSpeed

tRaw = dynSpeed / maxSpeed
t = tRaw < 0.0 ? 0.0 : tRaw > 1.0 ? 1.0 : tRaw

rVal = 255.0 * t
gVal = 165.0 * t
bVal = 255.0 * (1.0 - t)

arrowCol = t > 0.8 ? "#ff8800" : t > 0.5 ? "#cc8844" : t > 0.2 ? "#4488cc" : "#0044ff"

highThresh = 0.8 * maxSpeed
lowThresh = 0.1 * maxSpeed

highAlert = crossover(dynSpeed, highThresh)
calmAlert = crossunder(dynSpeed, lowThresh)

dx = tailLen * 3.0 * cos(yawRad)
dy = tailLen * 2.0 * sin(pitchRad)
tipX = 0.0 + dx
tipY = 0.0 + dy

arrow.new(0, 0, tipX, tipY, arrowCol, 2, "windArrow")

tipSig = highAlert or calmAlert

if highAlert {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "HighWind", "triangledown", "#ff8800")
}

if calmAlert {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Calm", "triangleup", "#0044ff")
}

if tipSig {
  plotshape_3d(tipX, tipY, "Tip", "diamond", arrowCol, markerSize, 2, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}

plot(dynSpeed, "Wind Speed kn", "#4488cc", 1, "separate")
plot(tailLen, "Tail Length", "#ff8800", 1, "separate")

plot3d(dynSpeed, "Wind Speed", "ribbon", "#4488cc", "separate")
plot3d(tailLen, "Tail Length", "trail", "#ff8800", "separate", 1)

plotshape_3d(0, 0, "Origin", "sphere", "#ffffff", 0.5, 0, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)

pxn := fxn
pyn := fyn
pzn := fzn
